settled_decisions.text: DB is the single source of truth; config.yml removed entirely.
Secrets + bootstrap in a gitignored .env, loaded via python-dotenv.
Everything non-bootstrap → DB, UI-editable, pydantic defaults as fallback (sparse override doc).
Storage = single-row JSONB app_settings document + source_configs table (Approach A).
Everything UI-editable hot-applies (worker resize, scheduler reconfig, presentation, connections); .env restart-only.
One-time import then delete config.yml; generic seed seam WORKBENCH_CONFIG_SEED; meta migration separate.
UI manages env-var reference NAMES; server never writes .env; PATCH re-runs load_dotenv(override=False).
logging + server host/port in .env, read-only in UI.

bubble_ups.answer: Define generic seed seam (WORKBENCH_CONFIG_SEED) here; meta migration separate.

bubble_ups.q: new-secret flow when env var not yet in process env
bubble_ups.answer: Re-read .env on PATCH (load_dotenv override=False) so new vars resolve live.

key_findings: auth_token.py has NO rotation today -> token is .env-only (open item resolved).
/api/config has no external consumer -> remove public route; /api/debug/config retained.
PipelineEngine + WorkbenchScheduler + IngestionQueueWorker capture config at construction -> appliers must mutate live objects + rebind scheduler.config.
No app-level Settings class exists -> 'settings' vocabulary is free to adopt.
Pass 2: entrypoint boot-break (__main__/cli_main load_config) + redaction-vs-env-ref contradiction.
Pass 3: llm is required-no-default with no stub provider -> no-seed first boot hard-fails unless llm seeded.
Pass 4: converged, zero material issues, all code refs verified.
Pre-existing latent bug (out of scope): scheduler.content_generators read at scheduler.py:497 but never assigned.
